summary: auth-otp ships filesystem and system enumeration with HTTP exfiltration in lib/core.js
details: The npm package auth-otp@1.0.1 contains lib/core.js which combines fs, os, child_process, http and https imports with base64 decoding primitives and reads from os.homedir(). The module wires filesystem existence checks and process-spawning together with outbound https.request/POST calls targeting a hardcoded hostname, which is the shape of installer-side data collection and exfiltration rather than an OTP helper. The Buffer.from base64 constructions at lines 37, 81, 83, 89 and 106 reconstruct obfuscated strings used by the network path. The purported purpose of the package (one-time-password authentication) does not require child_process execution, home-directory scanning, or outbound HTTP from a core module.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
